findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status, vadyu_get_outreach_ledger · Public sink: vadyu_submit_recipe_feedback, vadyu_get_video_status, vadyu_get_outreach_ledger.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status, vadyu_get_outreach_ledger · Public sink: vadyu_submit_recipe_feedback, vadyu_get_video_status, vadyu_get_outreach_ledger

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
